title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: Call 1 sends a 1,250-token request and the model answers with a 30-token tool request. The program runs the tool and gets a 200-token result. How many input tokens does call 2 send?
On Monday a student told the assistant they need a bench near the door. On Tuesday, in a new session, the assistant does not mention it. Nothing was saved. What is the best explanation?

options.text: The model forgot it because the window filled up
The new window started empty and nothing put it back
The provider deletes every chat after one day
The model cannot remember anything from a student

items.stem: The makerspace manuals total 120,000 tokens. A team pastes all of them into the request on every call. One student request takes 4 calls. How many input tokens do the manuals alone add across those 4 calls?
Which fact should the assistant get by calling a tool that reads the makerspace's own record, not from retrieval or from the model's notes?

options.text: The CNC router's spindle speed table
Whether this student passed CNC training
That this student likes quiet afternoons
The assistant's role and its tone of voice

items.stem: At the start of a new session, what does the assistant do to get a student's saved notes back into its context window? Answer in one sentence.
